title: Henna
desc: An Indian man falls into a river, losing his memory and drifting into Pakistan. Villagers care for him, but tragedy strikes when his forgotten past painfully resurfaces.

title: Maine Pyar Kiya
desc: Prem and Suman's love story faces a tough test when family feuds drive them apart. Can Prem overcome the obstacles and prove he's deserving of Suman's heart?

title: Koyla
desc: Shankar, a mute servant, tricks Gauri into marrying his employer with a false photo. But Gauri falls for Shankar, fighting against odds to be with him.

title: Jaat
desc: In a quiet coastal village ruled by fear, Varadaraja Ranatunga's tyranny goes unchecked-until a wandering stranger's clash with his men exposes the villagers' silent suffering.

title: Arjun Son Of Vyjayanthi
desc: In Order To Protect The People Of His Village, A Man Becomes A Ruthless Vigilante Against His Police Officer Mother'S Wishes.

title: O' Romeo
desc: A skilled enforcer helps a woman seek justice for her husband's death. As danger grows and enemies close in, their bond deepens amid betrayal and revenge.

title: Code Name: Tiranga
desc: An undercover agent sets out to avenge the 2001 terrorist attacks on Indian soil, but her pursuit of justice soon leads her to a dangerous point of no return.

title: Main Khiladi Tu Anari
desc: Inspector Karan seeks justice for his brother Arjun's murder. But Deepak, an actor, complicates things by shadowing him to add realism to his role.

title: Biwi Ho To Aisi
desc: Suraj secretly marries Shalu, a village belle, defying his domineering mother Kamla. To drive Shalu away, Kamla falsely accuses her of stealing jewellery and money.

title: Honeymoon Travels Pvt. Ltd
desc: Six newly married couples unravel secrets about their respective spouses and also resolve their issues and mend their sorrows.

title: Saaho
desc: An undercover agent and his partner chase a thief who stole 2,000 crore. Soon, they uncover links to a crime lord's death and a brewing gang war.

title: Paltan
desc: Lieutenant Colonel Raj Singh Yadav leads his soldiers to defend Nathu La Pass from Chinese forces. Amid fierce battles, they struggle with the pain of being far from their families.

title: Mission Majnu
desc: During the 1971 Indo-Pakistani War, a RAW agent infiltrates Pakistan to expose nuclear plans. He must alert India while avoiding disaster, risking everything to protect his nation's future.

title: Singham Again
desc: Drawing parallels to the Ramayana, Bajirao Singham leads his team on a daring mission to rescue his wife while facing a powerful and mysterious enemy.

title: Iqbal
desc: Iqbal, a hearing- and speech-impaired boy, dreams of playing for India. When his condition blocks his selection, he turns to a retired coach to train him for his dream.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.
